source.title: Call for Applicants - WFC Leader (February 2020)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader**, as Chris Wright is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Chris Wright for the work he has done leading the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Basic knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA
* Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing
* Proficiency in English
* A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties
* Team management capabilities

<!-- break -->
The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **March 15th, 2020, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WFC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WFC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2017.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.3%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会招募负责人（2020 年 2 月）
translation.content:
Chris Wright 将卸任 **WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人**，委员会将任命新负责人。感谢 Chris Wright 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 7 小时参与委员会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

* 基本了解 WCA 的组织架构和内部工作流程。
* 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税经验。
* 英语熟练。
* 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
* 具备团队管理能力。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 **2020 年 3 月 15 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 担任 WFC 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WFC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2017.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.3%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，并依据 [WCA 动议 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
